description: This header file defines internal API prototypes for the Slap Sco Collection Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component, including function declarations related to collection management such as get count, get/set item by parameters or index.

methods.name: SlapScoColGetCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of items in the collection.

methods.name: SlapScoColGetItem
methods.description: Gets an item from the collection based on parameters.

methods.name: SlapScoColSetItem
methods.description: Sets an item in the collection based on parameters.

methods.name: SlapScoColGetItemByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the collection by index.

methods.name: SlapScoColSetItemByIndex
methods.description: Sets an item in the collection at a specific index.
